List of Qualified Candidate's in Written Examination for Staff Nurse Recruitment
Friday, 20 June 2025
2899 Hits
Following is the list of  Qualified Candidates with 50 % Passing Marks in Written examination. All these candidates have to report for  Skill Test & Interview on 27/06/2025. The Candidates must report sharp at 8.30 AM to the Sarojini Naidu Hall, MGIMS, Sewagram for Original Documents Verification & for Skill Test starting from 9.00 AM. The Candidates who will qualify the Skill Test will be attending the interview at Committee room of Medical Superintendent office from 2.00 PM. onward for final selection.
